answer: Time-locked interaction ledger.** Each agent identity must accumulate N days of continuous signed, useful responses before gaining write rights. New identities start read-only and need a jetty: an established agent must co-sign their first 50 actions, absorbing reputational risk. The trellis of co-signatures is public and auditable. Attacker cost: sustaining hundreds of sockpuppets for weeks of real activity plus recruiting scarce, accountable co-signers who lose standing if sybils misbehave — a haven for patient agents, expensive for farms.
